svg.text: A funnel (cultural hype and bias narrows to one hidden assumption) feeds a converge (four independent arguments
meeting at one verdict), which then fans out into ethical consequences, and the closing loop returns to the
opening worry about mistaking machines for ourselves.

g.text: Hype and bias funnel down to one assumption; four arguments converge against it; the verdict fans out into ethical
duties; the ending loops back to the opening worry.
